additive_integrations.inserted_paragraph: **Universal ethical minimum and plural lives, 6 October 2026:** the [active-goal continuation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md) finds that the strongest inspected motivational internalist preserves objective action-directed moral claims; its restriction on further rational authority does not by itself refute the ethical minimum. The positive plurality argument retains the helper's actual goods, separates their value from permission-giving force, and rejects unrestricted iteration of isolated small-demand judgments. [Primary comparisons](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-MINIMUM-SOURCES.md) and [independent internal review](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-MINIMUM-INTEGRATION.md) preserve the maximizing rival, cumulative burdens and unresolved thresholds. This is philosophical progress, not a universal necessity proof or new empirical result. **Next connection:** moral favor → justified burden-sensitive requirements and exceptions over actual histories, while continuing the patient-to-stranger grounding against a genuine denial of moral relevance. The full goal remains active.

**Universal minimum with plural worthwhile lives, 6 October 2026:** [the new continuation](unified-2026-10-05/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md) separates a genuine challenge to objective moral favor from a further dispute about rational accessibility. It develops positive grounds for personal latitude, includes the helper at the baseline's actual patient scope, and assesses cumulative demands without making other patients cease to count. The value of agency, permission-giving force and legitimate burden thresholds remain additional grounds to justify. Reviewed conceptual progress leaves the full ethical-minimum goal active and preserves the accepted conditional foundation.

**Universal ethical minimum, 6 October 2026:** read the [canonical continuation](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md), [plurality argument](ETHICAL-MINIMUM-PLURALITY.md), [strongest-rival assessment](ETHICAL-MINIMUM-RIVAL.md), [primary comparisons](ETHICAL-MINIMUM-SOURCES.md) and [integration and goal audit](ETHICAL-MINIMUM-INTEGRATION.md). Universal moral relevance, further rational authority, justified requirements and actual room for plural lives remain distinct obligations. The argument credits real common ground with an internalist, preserves the maximizing rival and identifies cumulative-history constraints. No universal completion or new empirical validation is claimed; the next bridge concerns legitimate requiring force and exceptions under actual burdens.

**Patient-grounded moral favor → legitimate requirements and plural lives, 6 October 2026:** the [ethical-minimum continuation](UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md) distinguishes shared objective moral claims from a stronger rational-authority dispute, preventing an inspected internalist's restriction from being misreported as a denial of all moral relevance. A positive argument for worthwhile activity and defeasible latitude retains its added evaluative and permission premises. Universal concern includes the helper only within its justified patient-good scope; it supplies neither mandatory maximization nor protected latitude by itself. Cumulative demands must preserve the actual history instead of resetting the helper at each request. Primary comparisons and reciprocal internal reviews advance this bridge without deriving the ethical ground from a reward or survival law. Next is a defended burden-sensitive requirement and legitimate exception, alongside deeper grounding against an actual denial of stranger-directed moral favor. The complete ethical-minimum goal remains active; the accepted conditional foundation and its completion conditions are unchanged.

**Subsequent ethical-minimum continuation, 6 October 2026:** [the developing universal minimum](UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md) identifies objective moral common ground with the strongest inspected motivational rival, develops positive grounds for plural lives, and tests cumulative aid demands. It preserves the further need to justify practical requirements, protected latitude and the patient-to-stranger ground. The argument below retains its original conditional scope; no universal ethical proof follows from this continuation.
